note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English, with all three castes described; the soldier's length with rostrum is not recorded because of OCR damage. Distribution records, synonymic citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate body length with wings 12.0 mm and 5.5 mm without wings, antennae 15-segmented, postclypeus 2.5 times as wide as long; soldier head capsule circular in dorsal view and with an elevation behind the rostrum in lateral view, antennae 12-segmented, mandibles vestigial without spine-like processes; worker antennae 13-segmented, anterior lobe of the pronotum large and strongly protruding.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow, rostrum brownish; body nearly white. Head sparsely pilose with hairs of moderate length; abdominal tergites and sternites more densely pilose, hairs longer near the apex. Body length about 4.0 mm. Head circular in dorsal view, length without rostrum 0.87 mm, width 0.98–1.05 mm; in lateral view humped behind the rostrum. Rostrum narrow and cylindrical, almost as long as the head without rostrum, 0.75 mm long. Antennae 12-segmented, of moderate length; segment 3 almost 2 times as long as segment 2; segments 4 and 5 subequal, slightly longer than segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, without spine-like processes. Pronotum saddle-shaped, 0.49 mm wide; anterior lobe protruding, anterior margin without a notch. Abdomen large and thick.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head and body white, grey intestinal contents visible through the abdomen. Head and abdominal tergites moderately pilose. Body length about 4.00 mm. Head pentagonal and rounded; head capsule subcircular, widest at the antennae, length of head from the apex of the labrum 0.99–1.30 mm, head width 1.04 mm. Fontanelle plate shining, situated at the centre of the head. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3 and as long as segment 4. Postclypeus raised, anterior margin straight, posterior margin rounded, much shorter than half its width. Pronotum with a large, strongly protruding anterior lobe, anterior margin without a notch, 0.53 mm wide.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown, compound eyes black; body brown and covered with short pale yellow hairs; wings smoky brown; antennae and postclypeus yellow. Body length with wings 12.0 mm, without wings 5.5 mm. Head oval, 1.25 mm long. Fontanelle large and distinct, long oval. Compound eyes round and large. Ocelli long oval, separated from the compound eye by their minor diameter. Antennae 15-segmented, segments 3 and 4 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 3 very slightly longer and narrower than segment 4; segment 5 very slightly smaller than segment 4. Postclypeus raised and protruding, 2.5 times as wide as long. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head including the compound eyes, transverse and trapezoidal, wider than long; anterior margin straight, anterior angles rounded, lateral margins slightly convex, posterior margin slightly incurved. Wings brown, membrane punctate, margins and apex pilose.
